posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
My hypothesis for the final stretch goal is promos for the following heroes:

KNYFE, Ra, The Scholar, Guise, NightMist, and then either Naturalist, Chrono-Ranger, or Cleverest Legacy.

Here’s my logic. Counting all the heroes that are not getting promos with this expansioni got these, the Freedom 5, Unity, The original 4 Dark Watch, and the Sentinels. Not counting completionist Guise. I don’t see the Sentinels getting anything, because of the Void Guard, and the Freedom 6+ ask have a whole bunch of promos as is. Plus, the Dark Watch are a group, so I don’t see them all getting promos.

As far as characters that are relevant to the story, The Scholar and Guise have been fighting off Aeon Men together for a while, which is why I think they are likely candidates. Ra hasn’t gotten a promo in AGES, and KNYFE if directly linked to this whole thing. And then there’s NightMist, with the whole “Be The Gate thing.”

That leaves 1 promo left. Honestly, I don’t see how relevant Chrono-Ranger and Naturalist are to this whole arc, and it would be a really fitting love letter to the fans to include, as the $1,000,000 stretch goal, the promo we’ve all been begging for, even though they’ve said that they weren’t going to.
